How can I start Star Investigation? (Oct. 11/2023 7 Wonders Chapter 4.0 Polaris)

1. Pre-requisite (Discoveries)

1) Polaris
2) Ursa Major
3) Ursa Minor Here!

2. Go to Pisa and Meet "Galileo Galilei" and start Star Investigation.
You can check Ursa Minor at your ingame menu "Nothern Sky"
(Journal>Star Atlas>Nothern Sky>Ursa Minor) You have to chart this constellation at first.

3. Report your investigation of "Ursa Minor" to "Galileo Garlilei" and confirm all constellations in "Star Atlas" menu which you have discovered already. Now, you can choose and chart one of them.

NOTE 1: Coordinates ( -, 4096) is the extension of a Sea Zone line between
Arguin and Cabo Verde



NOTE 2: You have to discover the target constellation before charting!!

4. Constellations (Total 25 Based on Chapter 4.1 Soundcraft)

● Disband your fleet when you discover Constellations. Discoveries from Age/Quest/Treasure Maps all, you have to disband. recommend it would be better you disband your fleet though your discoveries are the second trials.

● Please take care NOT to lose your treaure map when you recognize a target constellation on the sea which has an Age Constellation.
